project_type: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces): React+Vite frontend (JA/EN i18n), AWS Lambda backend, DynamoDB, Amazon Bedrock chat, AWS CDK infra. Digimon-style monster-raising game ('AIモンスター' / AI Monster). This task is GitHub issue #29: visualize care needs. Today the monster's state is a single 'きぶん' (mood) text line; hungryLevel is invisible so players cannot tell when to feed/clean despite a neglect penalty. Add a hunger/fullness gauge to StatsPanel (hungryLevel 0..10 full->hungry), enhance the sprite-adjacent state badges (hunger NEW, dirty 💢 exists, sleeping 💤 exists) with a caution color near threshold, refactor mood derivation into a pure function taking hungryLevel/dirty/HP (and isSleeping) that is unit-tested, do NOT rely on color alone (icon + accessible label), JA/EN parity for all strings.
build_system: npm workspaces. npm is NOT on the default PATH in this sandbox; prepend `export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"` before any npm command. Root scripts: build (shared->backend->frontend->infra via tsc/vite), test (shared node:test). Frontend build is `tsc && vite build`.
test_framework: node:test built-in runner. Shared tests under packages/shared (baseline 47/47 PASS confirmed). Frontend pure-helper tests in packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts run via `npm test -w packages/frontend` i.e. `node --experimental-strip-types --test src/game-ui.test.ts` (baseline 50/50 PASS confirmed).
build_command: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" && npm run build  (root). Verified green at baseline.
test_command: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" && npm test  (root, shared expected 47/47) AND `cd packages/frontend && npm test` (frontend ui-helpers, expected >=50; this task ADDS tests so count rises).
verification_instructions: 1) `npm run build` at root stays green (frontend tsc enforces i18n key parity: a missing ja or en entry is a compile error; a signature change to moodLabel must compile at its call site in StatsPanel.tsx). 2) `npm test` at root -> shared tests still pass (adding an export to game.ts must NOT break the 47). 3) `cd packages/frontend && npm test` -> all ui-helpers tests pass, including the new mood tests and the intentionally-updated existing moodLabel/moodLabelJa tests. 4) Optionally `npm run dev` + playwright to eyeball the gauge/badges. Network OPEN_INTERNET. Do NOT deploy (orchestrator redeploys at the end of the batch).
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/frontend/dist (vite build output, gitignored). None checked in.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/kiro-digitalmonster (deps already installed). Remember the PATH export above. Branch off main as feat/care-needs-indicators.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. CANNOT git push or open PRs (orchestrator handles that). Commit locally on the feature branch only. Do NOT touch backup/previous-main branches. No new runtime dependencies allowed. npm requires the PATH export noted above.
contribution_requirements: Feature branch off main named feat/care-needs-indicators. Logically-separated commits. Frontend-focused; the only shared change allowed is exporting the already-existing MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL constant (and optionally a caution-threshold const) from packages/shared/src/game.ts so the frontend reuses it rather than hardcoding a second copy. No backend/infra changes. JA output for the mood value must stay byte-identical to today WHERE the derived mood is unchanged; existing moodLabel/moodLabelJa tests may be intentionally updated to reflect the new HP-aware signature and must be explained. JA/EN parity for every new i18n key. No color-only cues (keep icon + aria-label/title). CSS in styles.css; respect prefers-reduced-motion if any animation is added.
key_patterns:
DOMAIN (packages/shared/src/game.ts): MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL=10 is a MODULE-PRIVATE const today -> export it (game.ts is re-exported via `export *` from packages/shared/src/index.ts, so `export const MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL` immediately becomes importable as `import { MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL } from '@ddm/shared'`). hungryLevel: 0=full, higher=hungrier, capped at 10. feed() reduces hunger by 3 and +5 HP; applyTimePassage raises hunger over ticks, sets dirty after >=3 ticks, and a monster at MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL loses HP per tick. Monster.stats has hp/maxHp. PURE HELPERS (packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts): the DOM/React-free, unit-tested layer. hpPercent(hp,maxHp)->0..100 clamped int already exists; statBarPercent(value,reference) exists. moodLabelJa(monster)/moodLabelEn(monster)/moodLabel(monster,lang) TODAY take Pick and branch: isSleeping->'すやすや睡眠中'/'Sleeping soundly'; dirty->'よごれている'/'Dirty'; hungryLevel>=7->'とてもお腹がすいている'/'Very hungry'; hungryLevel>=3->'お腹がすいてきた'/'Getting hungry'; else 'ごきげん'/'Happy'. BABY_SPEECH_TEXT shows the mirrored-constant documentation pattern to follow when mirroring a value. STATSPANEL (packages/frontend/src/components/StatsPanel.tsx): ATK_REFERENCE=40/DEF_REFERENCE=30; renders name+stage-badge header,

{t('stats.mood')}{moodLabel(monster,lang)}

, then HP/ATK/DEF .stat-row blocks each = {t(...)} +
+ ; then train-count; then the #8 evolution-progress block with ✓/・ met markers (aria-hidden). SPRITE OVERLAYS (packages/frontend/src/App.tsx inside .sprite-wrap): existing conditional spans {isSleeping && 💤} and {dirty && 💢}, plus #10 care-fx overlay and #11 SpeechBubble. i18n (packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts): JA_MESSAGES is the SOURCE OF TRUTH; MessageKey=keyof typeof JA_MESSAGES; EN_MESSAGES: Record so BOTH ja+en entries are required per key or the build fails. useI18n()->t(key). Existing stat keys: stats.mood/stats.hp/stats.atk/stats.def/stats.trainingCount etc. STYLES (packages/frontend/src/styles.css): .mood; .stat-row (grid 48px 1fr auto); .bar (bg, radius, height 12px, overflow hidden); .bar-fill (height 100%, transition width 0.4s); .bar-fill.hp/.atk/.def gradients; .sprite-wrap (position relative); .sprite-wrap .zzz,.dirt (position absolute, top 14px, 1.6rem; .zzz right 18px, .dirt left 18px); there are existing `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` blocks to extend if animation is added.
